posts.title: Nadal’s appointment to Real Madrid board ratified at general assembly
posts.description: The 22-time Grand Slam winner, an honorary club member since 2011, said joining the board was “a great responsibility”, as President Florentino Perez said his arrival would help the club succeed in the future

posts.title: Perfect week caps Mirra Andreeva’s star-making year
posts.description: The 19-year-old demolished the field at the WTA Finals in Indian Wells. The dominant performance against the world’s best, ending a season in which she won her first Major title, suggests she is growing into a player who can shape the future of women’s tennis

posts.title: Chintan Parikh and Rohit Rajpal file nominations for the post of AITA president
posts.description: Leander Paes and Prashant Sutar will vie for the post of vice-president
